children: CelcomDigi's 3Q core net profit is estimated to have increased 1%-3% sequentially, helped by lower costs, CIMB Securities analysts Choong Chen Foong and Kenny Lim say in a note. They tip 3Q core earnings up 4%-6% on year at 430 million-440 million ringgit. Service revenue may have remained flat as tighter prepaid SIM registration rules weighed on demand, although lower dealer commissions and SIM card costs should cushion the impact, they reckon. The analysts cut their 2026-2028 core earnings forecasts by 1%-4% to account for higher costs from additional spectrum rights, but expect network capacity and coverage to improve. CIMB maintains a buy rating on CelcomDigi and keeps its target price at 3.65 ringgit. Shares are 0.4% lower at 2.53 ringgit. (yingxian.wong@wsj.com)
